newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIFCO has Singapore, Luxembourg nod to list notes.
newsitem.headline: SIFCO has Singapore, Luxembourg nod to list notes.

text.p: Securitization & Infrastructure Funding Corporation (SIFCO) said on Friday it has received in-principle approval to list its US$500 million notes issue on the Stock Exchange of Singapore and the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
It said in a statement that it has appointed Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd and Nomura Singapore Ltd to jointly lead manage the first issue under the US$500 million medium term note programme.
The funds raised under the programme will be used by SIFCO to purchase certain investments and to pay costs and expenses.
The note programme is guaranteed by Asian Securitization & Infrastructure Assurance (Pte) Ltd (ASIA Ltd).
Based on ASIA Ltd's guarantee, the note programme has been rated AA+ by Nippon Investors Services Inc, AA by Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co, and A by Standard and Poor's Ratings Services.
Details of the first issue will be finalized after a roadshow to be conducted in Hong Kong, London, Singapore, Taipei and Tokyo starting December 2, it said.
